comment.author: Hanran Yang
paragraphs: 1.1 Verification is fully automated and requires no manual intervention.
1.2 A machine enters the verification pool when its reliability is greater than 0.9. This is the gate; the higher the reliability, the more likely it is to be verified.
1.3 One physical CPU core is required per GPU.
1.4 It depends on your self-test image. If you want to include them, you may need to add a version with PyTorch that supports them.
1.5 Stopped means the container and data are still on the machine.
1.6 If the current price is lower than or equal to the previous price, it will auto-extend.
1.7 This is a hard requirement, not just a recommendation.
1.8 Ubuntu 24.04 LTS is now the preferred version. Ubuntu 22.04 also works.
1.9 The Vast CLI can be run from any machine.
1.10 We recommend 100 ports per GPU. More is better so you do not run out of ports.
1.11 I am not sure where this is coming from. We use XFS to enforce quotas.

related_port_clarification.author: Hanran Yang
related_port_clarification.body: 64 is the _maximum_ mapped per instance. When many instances stop on a machine, the port remains occupied by that instance. Having more ports than a instances can have is to prevents instances from occupying all ports with stored instances and blocks new rentals.
